name: Service Level
definition: Agreement under which or rules under which the transaction should be processed.

Code.name: Code
Code.definition: Identification of a pre-agreed level of service between the parties in a coded form.

Other.name: Other
Other.definition: SWIFT defined service level applies to the payment instruction.

Bilateral.name: Bilateral
Bilateral.definition: Unambiguous identification of a pre-agreed level of service between the parties.

PaymentProcessing.name: Payment Processing
PaymentProcessing.definition: Payment process for which a service level is specified.
